h1: AI Instagram Ads from One Product Photo
lead: Paste a product link or start from one photo. Pick an actor and a voice, see the credit cost first, and publish the Instagram ad or download it with no watermark.
card: Instagram ads from one product photo, as a tall clip or a square still.

faq.q: What can I make here for Instagram?
faq.a: A tall clip for Reels and Stories, or a square still for the grid, from a product link or one photo. You can add an actor, a script, a voiceover and captions. The credit cost shows first.

faq.q: How do I make an Instagram ad from a link?
faq.a: Paste the product page. A script, pictures and captions can be drafted for you. Pick an actor and a voice, choose the tall clip or the square still, then publish or download.

faq.q: Do you have ready-made Reel layouts?
faq.a: Yes. Start from a Reel, Story or feed template, then swap the product, the actor and the line. You can also describe one moment with no template.
A still costs 24 credits. A clip costs 24, 40, 60 or 120 credits for 6, 10, 15 or 30 seconds, and the price shows before you start. If a job fails, those credits return on their own.

faq.q: Are music, captions and a voice included?
faq.a: Yes. A clip can include captions, a voiceover and a music track. Change them in the editor before you publish or download. The file has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I publish the file as a paid ad?
faq.a: Yes. Publish it to Instagram or Meta from here, or download it and upload it yourself. Follow the current ad-review prompts for the market where the ad will run.

faq.q: Do I need a creator or a studio?
faq.a: No. Pick someone from the actor library, or make your own twin. If a person appears, that presenter is generated. It is not a real customer and not a creator you booked.

faq.q: Which frame should I check before export?
faq.a: Compare your placement with [social media ad sizes](/guides/ad-sizes-by-platform), then preview the file so interface controls do not cover the item.
